description: This file provides utility functions for handling idle timeouts in LLM streaming responses, including resolving timeout values from configuration and wrapping stream functions to enforce idle timeouts.

methods.name: resolveLlmIdleTimeoutMs
methods.description: Resolves the LLM idle timeout in milliseconds from the provided configuration, defaulting if necessary.

methods.name: streamWithIdleTimeout
methods.description: Wraps a stream function to add idle timeout detection, aborting the stream if no token is received within the specified timeout.
